_what_this_file_is: The HUMAN governance decision, recorded in git so it is reviewable and
versioned. It authorises nothing by itself: the runtime stage fails closed
record onto the store, which is what stamps the prospective epoch floor.
The decision travels in the repository; the epoch floor is stamped once at
deployment, from the data, and is immutable thereafter.
authorisation_excludes: does NOT reset its historical inception
does NOT erase the missing 21 sessions
does NOT make it capital eligible

_why: The owned trailing panel prices all 100 frozen names and SPY on 100% of
these 21 sessions, so the data to reconstruct them exists. That is
exactly why the rule matters: a mark written now for 2026-08-17 would be
a retrospective computation wearing the label of a prospective one, and
the only property this book exists to measure is that its outcomes were
unobservable when its specification was frozen.

root_cause.producer_defect: NONE - the producer was correct and remains unchanged
root_cause.statement: the mark producer's host was retired 13 days before the book existed, so the book never had one opportunity to accrue a mark
root_cause.remedy: re-parent the FROZEN producer onto the ONE canonical runtime

prospective_epoch.observation_epoch_starts: the first eligible completed session STRICTLY AFTER the epoch floor stamped at activation
prospective_epoch.epoch_floor_rule: max(2026-09-15, the latest completed session in the owned panel at activation)
_why_two_dates: Silently pretending collection began in August would make a re-armed
clock indistinguishable from a book that had been accruing for a month.
The strategy identity keeps ONE inception; the OBSERVATION epoch is
governance metadata recorded around that same identity.

frozen_horizon_contract.rule_is: B - number of legitimately collected marks
frozen_horizon_contract.rule_is_not: A - elapsed eligible market sessions since inception
frozen_horizon_contract.source_quote: forward_observations counts recorded marks; a horizon with fewer marks than its length is PENDING, never scored
frozen_horizon_contract.consequence: a 21-session gap does not corrupt the h63 clock, because the clock counts marks and zero marks is zero progress

collection_rules.duplicate_same_session_mark: impossible - ShadowBook.record_mark refuses a date at or before the latest mark
guards: guard 1: the prospective epoch floor, stamped once at activation
guard 2: an explicit refusal of any session inside 2026-08-17..2026-09-15
guard 3 (pre-existing, frozen): ShadowBook.record_mark refuses a date at or before inception or the latest mark
_why_guard_1_is_not_optional: ShadowBook.record_mark alone does NOT protect the forfeited window. With
zero marks recorded its only bound is inception 2026-08-16, so the frozen
producer would accept 2026-09-15. At the time of this repair the owned
panel's newest session WAS 2026-09-15 and every post-inception session it
could price was one of the 21 - so wiring the producer up without a floor
would have minted a forfeited session as its first 'forward' mark.
